name: file_type
description: Say what a file is from its first bytes, and whether that agrees with its extension, for a file or a directory walked in sorted order. Identifies with a table of forensic signatures (PE, ELF, Mach-O universal vs Java class by their own fields, archives, registry hives, event logs, prefetch at offset 4 and compressed MAM, shortcuts, AD1 and E01, memory captures) and, for what the table does not know, the installed `file` (libmagic) when present. An identification is a reading of the first bytes, not a validation. A type nothing knows is unrecognised and its extension_matches is null, neither match nor mismatch. Hashes every regular file it opens (SHA-256); symbolic links and non-regular files are listed, never opened or followed. examined counts files actually opened; every result is kept in all_results when the inline page (limit, mismatch_only) is not the whole, and unreadable files are reported as errors whatever mismatch_only says.

path.description: A file, or a directory to walk

mismatch_only.description: Show inline only files whose bytes disagree with their extension (errors and the complete result are still reported)

limit.description: Maximum files shown inline (default 500); every file looked at is in all_results when there are more
